title: Design System: BakerRang Consumer Ecosystem

gold.note: Fill only: brand mark + single primary action + ::selection. Paired with dark ink.

gold-text.note: Accent text/icon strokes/focus. #FFD500 on dark, #8a6300 deep-gold on light.

ink-on-gold.note: Dark text/glyph placed on gold fills. Never white.

danger.note: Destructive actions only (e.g. Sign out); never decorative.

desk.note: The ground the pages lie on. Dark = world Ground; light deliberately #e6e1d8 (vs world #efece6) so a white page reads as a sheet. Story Book only (product layer).

desk-2.note: Recessed desk step (segmented theme track in the avatar menu). Story Book only (product layer).

page.note: Reading-layer page plane: leaf + spread. Story Book only (product layer).

page-2.note: Recessed page fills: plate/thumb/slot ground, entry hover, skeleton. Story Book only (product layer).

page-line.note: On-page hairline: gutter, contents rules, plate ring, steps. Story Book only (product layer).

page-ink.note: Story text and titles on the page. Story Book only (product layer).

page-ink-2.note: Secondary page text: first lines, captions, plate titles. Story Book only (product layer).

page-ink-3.note: Muted page text: folios, running heads, meta, placeholders. Story Book only (product layer).

page-dim.note: Not-yet-spoken text during Read aloud; current chunk returns to Page Ink. Story Book only (product layer).

finder.note: The near-black camera object and the caption strip. Fixed in both themes: the finder is a camera, not a surface. Sign only (product layer).

finder-rail.note: The finder's top info rail, one step above the finder. Fixed in both themes: the finder is a camera, not a surface. Sign only (product layer).

finder-well.note: Letterbox around the video plate. Fixed in both themes: the finder is a camera, not a surface. Sign only (product layer).

finder-ink.note: Caption glyph and name, idle-plate messages. Fixed in both themes: the finder is a camera, not a surface. Sign only (product layer).

finder-ink-2.note: Lit rail items, quiet caption name, caption side slot, problem icons. Fixed in both themes: the finder is a camera, not a surface. Sign only (product layer).

finder-ink-3.note: Rail labels, caption meta, empty glyph hand, problem explanations. Fixed in both themes: the finder is a camera, not a surface. Sign only (product layer).

finder-line.note: Hairlines inside the finder (under the rail, above the caption, beside the glyph column). Fixed in both themes: the finder is a camera, not a surface. Sign only (product layer).

finder-edge.note: The finder's 1px outer border: the only finder token that follows the theme, because it draws the camera's edge against the ground. Sign only (product layer).

finder-overlay.note: Video-safe white over the camera image: crop marks at rest and skeleton lines. Joints, locked crop marks and the reading glyph are #fff; crop marks dim to rgba(255,255,255,0.34) while the camera is off. Fixed in both themes: the finder is a camera, not a surface. Sign only (product layer).

display.purpose: Masthead statement of what BakerRang is. Archivo Expanded 800, tight tracking.

headline.purpose: Section mastheads (e.g. 'What's on the bench'). Archivo Expanded.

title.purpose: Tool names in directory rows and the vault. Archivo Expanded 700.

body.purpose: Leads, descriptions, UI copy. Archivo, slightly tight tracking.

label.purpose: Group titles and eyebrow labels, uppercase, wide tracking, Ink-3.

story-body.purpose: Recto story text. Literata 400, opsz 16, lh 1.62, fitted to spread height; 19px on phone. Scoped exception to the Expanded-for-Naming Rule (Story Book content only).

story-title.purpose: Story titles: recto page-one heading and compose heading (Literata 600, opsz 60; 30px phone). Contents-entry titles, rename field, dialog-quoted title and the italic reading-bar running title also use Literata.

masthead.purpose: Story Book mastheads: the 'Stories' contents title (Literata 600, opsz 72), welcome headline, not-found heading. The 'Story Book' wordmark stays Archivo Expanded.

folio.purpose: Page numbers at the foot of each page: Literata 500 13px, old-style numerals, Page Ink 3, outer-edge aligned (centred on phone).

poly-said-latest.purpose: The newest log entry's translation: Archivo 500, Ink, 36em measure; 1.9rem on phone (poly-said-latest-phone). The loudest line on the instrument.

poly-said-latest-long.purpose: Newest translation over 64 characters drops one step; 1.55rem on phone (poly-said-latest-long-phone).

poly-said.purpose: Translations of earlier turns, Ink 2; 1.02rem on phone (poly-said-phone).

poly-said-sample.purpose: Newest translation inside the Welcome example conversation.

poly-heard.purpose: What was heard, set small above the translation: Archivo 400 15px Ink 3.

poly-turn-no.purpose: Zero-padded tabular turn number in the log gutter, Ink 3.

poly-turn-dir.purpose: Direction code (EN→ES) under the turn number, uppercase Ink 3; tracking 0.05em on phone.

poly-stage.purpose: Heard · Translated · Spoken labels under the stage rule (10px / 0.04em on phone).

poly-talk.purpose: Label on the gold talk key (Speak English / Stop 0:04 / Translating…).

poly-empty-title.purpose: First-use instruction in the empty log. Plain Archivo 600, not Expanded.

poly-welcome.purpose: Signed-out Welcome headline: Archivo Expanded 800, all Ink, no gold accentword.

sign-caption-glyph.purpose: The reading as text of record in the caption strip: Archivo Expanded 800 40px, Finder Ink; 44px on phone (sign-caption-glyph-phone). The loudest mark on the viewfinder.

sign-caption-glyph-long.purpose: Multi-character glyphs (ILY) in the caption: 22px; 20px on phone (sign-caption-glyph-long-phone).

sign-caption-name.purpose: 'Letter L' beside the glyph: Archivo 600 18px Finder Ink; quiet states drop to 500 Finder Ink 2; 16px on phone (sign-caption-name-phone).

sign-caption-meta.purpose: Line under the caption name ('Reading · steady'): 500 12.5px Finder Ink 3.

sign-rail.purpose: Camera info rail: 600 11px uppercase 0.09em Finder Ink 3; 10.5px / 0.07em on phone (sign-rail-phone).

sign-howto.purpose: The target's words-only how-to sentence: 400 15px Ink 2, max 52ch, reserves two lines; 14.5px at <=760px (sign-howto-phone).

sign-hold-state.purpose: Text state beside the hold rule: Make the shape / Hold it… / Held / Not yet / Reading only. 600 13.5px Ink 2, Ink when Held.

sign-key.purpose: Label on the gold camera key (Start camera / Starting… / Stop camera / Try again).

sign-target-glyph.purpose: Glyph in the Target trigger's 40px tile: Archivo Expanded 800 20px; 12px for long glyphs.

sign-cell.purpose: Glyph in each handshape picker cell: Archivo Expanded 700 22px; 13px for ILY.

sign-welcome.purpose: Signed-out Welcome headline: Archivo Expanded 800, all Ink, no gold accent word, max 13ch; 2.3rem on phone.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Structural elevation on genuinely raised objects: bench, vault, popovers, menus.

shadows.name: contact
shadows.purpose: Small contact shadow: segmented-control active pill, hovered directory row.

shadows.name: dock
shadows.purpose: Polyglot only: upward shadow on the docked composer (Plane slab + 1px Line top rule). The layer's one new shadow; the log itself is flat.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Default transition for background/border/color state changes.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Staggered bench-cell entrance; gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: page-turn
motion.purpose: Story Book page turn: page content slides 14px in the turn direction; running head stays; gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: arrive
motion.purpose: Polyglot: the arriving translation rises 6px from 35% opacity; gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: stage-breathe
motion.purpose: Polyglot: the current stage-rule segment breathes to 35% opacity; gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: sheet
motion.purpose: Polyglot: phone bottom sheet rises 24px; desktop pickers rise 4px over 0.16s.

motion.name: focus-lock
motion.purpose: Sign signature: on Held the four crop marks step 6px inward, thicken 1.5px to 3px and turn #fff, hold ~900ms, then release. Played forward by adding the lock class to the persistent crop element a frame after paint. Reduced motion: thicken only, no transform.

motion.name: hold-fill
motion.purpose: Sign: each of the 12 hold-rule segments fills to Ink as the 1.2s hold progresses.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.note: Masthead + ecosystem collapse to one column; bench moves below copy.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.note: Compact top-bar sign-in; theme labels hide; rows tighten; vault drops arrow.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.note: Wordmark hides; BakerRang logo mark carries the brand.

breakpoints.name: storybook-reader
breakpoints.note: Story Book: spread collapses to one column (plate full-bleed, then text); gutter/running heads/page rule drop; page becomes the screen; reading bar hides on scroll; fixed bottom page bar.

breakpoints.name: storybook-library
breakpoints.note: Story Book: contents leaf goes full-bleed; the single gold action moves to a fixed bottom bar.

breakpoints.name: polyglot-phone
breakpoints.note: Polyglot: turn gutter 44px, older turns use a single overflow (⋯) menu for Copy / Say it again, role labels and voice name hide, drive row = keyboard button + full-width talk key, pickers become bottom sheets, keyboard hint hides, bar rule hides.

breakpoints.name: polyglot-welcome
breakpoints.note: Polyglot Welcome collapses to one column.

breakpoints.name: polyglot-wordmark
breakpoints.note: Polyglot wordmark hides (the world rule says 430px; see notCanonized drift).

breakpoints.name: sign-welcome
breakpoints.note: Sign Welcome collapses to one column.

breakpoints.name: sign-stack
breakpoints.note: Sign: target line stacks (target, hold, key); how-to goes full width at 14.5px; camera key goes full width at 60px.

breakpoints.name: sign-phone
breakpoints.note: Sign: rail 30px, caption 64px glyph column / 62px tall with a 44px glyph, crop inset 12% 10%, hold row two rows at a fixed 76px, picker becomes a bottom sheet over a flat rgba(0,0,0,.45) scrim, bar rule hides.

breakpoints.name: sign-wordmark
breakpoints.note: Sign wordmark hides (the world rule says 430px; same drift as Polyglot, see notCanonized).

radii.name: control-inner
radii.purpose: Nested inner elements: segmented-control pills, chips, secure tag, focus radius.

radii.name: control
radii.purpose: Buttons, icon buttons, avatar, segmented control, emblem tiles.

components.name: Primary Button (Gold)
components.description: The single primary action. The only gold fill on a surface; dark ink on gold.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.5rem; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:4px; background:#FFD500; color:#1a1a1a; font:600 14px 'Archivo',sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.01em; cursor:pointer; transition:background .16s ease, transform .06s ease; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { background:#F0C400; } .ds-btn-gold:active { background:#DDBA00; transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #FFD500; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action: transparent with a strong hairline border, fills to Plane on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.5rem; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); border-radius:4px; background:transparent; color:#f2efe9; font:600 14px 'Archivo',sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.01em; cursor:pointer; transition:background .16s ease, border-color .16s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:#201f1d; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #FFD500; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Metadata Chip
components.description: Small metadata or action chip. Pair variant (tabular) is static; go variant takes the accent on hover.
components.html: EN ⇆ ES
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:3px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); background:#1c1b1a; color:#c3bfb6; font:600 11px 'Archivo',sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-chip--go { cursor:pointer; } .ds-chip--go:hover { border-color:var(--accent); color:var(--accent); }

components.name: Directory Row
components.description: The signature tool entry: an index row, not a card. Flat at rest, lifts and takes the tool accent on hover.
components.html:
Story Book
Write and illustrate a story with a few words, then have it read aloud.
components.css: .ds-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:60px 1fr auto; align-items:center; gap:1.1rem; padding:1.05rem 1rem; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid transparent; border-bottom-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.10); cursor:pointer; transition:background .16s, border-color .16s, transform .1s; } .ds-row:hover { background:#201f1d; border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.10); transform:translateX(2px); box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4); } .ds-row__em { width:52px; height:52px; border-radius:4px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; color:var(--accent); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, #201f1d); border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent); } .ds-row__em svg { width:30px; height:30px; } .ds-row__name { font-family:'Archivo Expanded',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:1.18rem; letter-spacing:-0.02em; color:#f2efe9; } .ds-row__desc { color:#c3bfb6; font:400 .95rem 'Archivo',sans-serif; margin-top:1px; } .ds-row__go { color:#928d83; transition:color .16s, transform .16s; } .ds-row__go svg { width:22px; height:22px; display:block; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row__go { color:var(--accent); transform:translateX(3px); }

components.name: Vault (high-trust module)
components.description: The distinct, sturdier zero-knowledge Passwords module. Always elevated, with a secure tag and masked dots.
components.html:
Passwords Zero-knowledge
A private vault that encrypts on your device. ••••••••
components.css: .ds-vault { --accent:#AEB8C2; display:grid; grid-template-columns:64px 1fr; align-items:center; gap:1.2rem; padding:1.5rem 1.4rem; border-radius:8px; background:#201f1d; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4), 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35); cursor:pointer; } .ds-vault:hover { border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, rgba(255,255,255,0.18)); } .ds-vault__em { width:58px; height:58px; border-radius:4px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; color:var(--accent); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 14%, #201f1d); border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 34%, transparent); } .ds-vault__em svg { width:32px; height:32px; } .ds-vault__name { font-family:'Archivo Expanded',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:1.3rem; letter-spacing:-.02em; color:#f2efe9; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.6rem; } .ds-vault__desc { color:#c3bfb6; font:400 .95rem 'Archivo',sans-serif; margin-top:2px; } .ds-vault__dots { letter-spacing:.18em; color:var(--accent); } .ds-tag-secure { font:700 11px 'Archivo',sans-serif; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.1em; color:var(--accent); border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent); padding:2px 7px; border-radius:3px; }

components.name: Segmented Theme Control
components.description: Light/dark/system control. Track is Plane; the pressed segment gets a Plane-2 pill and contact shadow.
components.css: .ds-seg { display:inline-flex; padding:3px; gap:2px; background:#201f1d; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-radius:4px; } .ds-seg button { appearance:none; border:0; background:transparent; color:#928d83; font:600 12px 'Archivo',sans-serif; padding:5px 9px; border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-seg button:hover { color:#f2efe9; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background:#262523; color:#f2efe9; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4); }

components.name: Spread (Story Book)
components.description: The flagship reading object: verso plate / 1px gutter rule / recto text, ~1.42:1, height-fitted, 8px panel radius, resting shadow on the desk. No fold shading.
components.html:
2
The Lighthouse That Forgot

On the last rock before the open sea stood a lighthouse named Wren. Every night for ninety years she had turned her great lamp in slow circles.

3
components.css: .ds-spread { --h:380px; height:var(--h); width:calc(var(--h) * 1.42); display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1px 1fr; background:#1f1c19; color:#ece4d8; border-radius:8px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4), 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35); overflow:hidden; } .ds-gutter { background:rgba(255,238,215,.09); } .ds-pg { display:flex; flex-direction:column; min-height:0; padding:calc(var(--h) * .075) calc(var(--h) * .07) calc(var(--h) * .055); } .ds-pg__head { font:600 11px/1 'Archivo',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#978d80; height:12px; margin-bottom:calc(var(--h) * .045); white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; } .ds-pg--recto .ds-pg__head, .ds-pg--recto .ds-pg__folio { text-align:right; } .ds-pg__folio { margin-top:auto; padding-top:14px; font:500 13px 'Literata',Georgia,serif; font-variant-numeric:oldstyle-nums; color:#978d80; } .ds-plate { flex:1; min-height:0; display:grid; place-items:center; } .ds-plate__img { width:min(100%, calc(var(--h) * .66)); aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:3px; background:#282420; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,238,215,.09); } .ds-text { flex:1; min-height:0; overflow:auto; font:400 16.5px/1.62 'Literata',Georgia,serif; font-variation-settings:'opsz' 16; color:#ece4d8; } .ds-text p { margin:0 0 .8em; }

components.name: Contents Entry (Story Book)
components.description: A table-of-contents line on the library leaf: thumb / Literata title + dotted leader + Archivo meta / kebab; first line beneath; ember ribbon when left mid-way. Flat at rest, Page 2 on hover.
components.html:
The Lighthouse That Forgot5 pages · 21 Sep

On the last rock before the open sea stood a lighthouse named Wren.
components.css: .ds-toc { background:#1f1c19; padding:8px 20px; border-radius:8px; } .ds-entry { position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:64px 1fr auto; gap:18px; align-items:center; padding:16px 10px; margin:0 -10px; border-radius:4px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,238,215,.09); cursor:pointer; transition:background .16s ease; } .ds-entry:hover { background:#282420; } .ds-thumb { position:relative; width:64px; height:64px; border-radius:3px; background:#282420; border:1px solid rgba(255,238,215,.09); } .ds-ribbon { position:absolute; top:-1px; right:8px; width:9px; height:22px; background:#F08A5D; clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,100% 100%,50% 76%,0 100%); } .ds-entry__body { min-width:0; } .ds-entry__top { display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:10px; } .ds-entry__title { font:600 1.22rem/1.25 'Literata',Georgia,serif; letter-spacing:-.01em; color:#ece4d8; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; } .ds-entry__lead { flex:1; min-width:24px; border-bottom:1.5px dotted #978d80; opacity:.55; transform:translateY(-4px); } .ds-entry__meta { font:500 13px 'Archivo',sans-serif; color:#978d80; white-space:nowrap; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-entry__meta b { color:#c2b8aa; font-weight:600; } .ds-entry__first { margin:4px 0 0; font:400 1rem/1.5 'Literata',Georgia,serif; color:#c2b8aa; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; } .ds-ibtn { display:inline-grid; place-items:center; width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid transparent; background:transparent; color:#978d80; cursor:pointer; } .ds-ibtn:hover { background:#1f1c19; color:#ece4d8; border-color:rgba(255,238,215,.09); } .ds-ibtn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #FFD500; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Plate (Story Book)
components.description: The verso picture: square, 3px inner radius, 1px Page Line ring on Page 2. When a picture fails, the typographic plate (large italic Literata folio + title) replaces it.
components.html:
4
The Lighthouse That Forgot
This page’s picture couldn’t be made.
components.css: .ds-plates { display:flex; gap:24px; padding:24px; background:#1f1c19; border-radius:8px; } .ds-plate-img { width:180px; aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:3px; background:#282420; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,238,215,.09); } .ds-plate-type { width:180px; aspect-ratio:1; display:grid; place-content:center; text-align:center; } .ds-plate-type .n { font:italic 400 84px/1 'Literata',Georgia,serif; font-variation-settings:'opsz' 72; color:#978d80; opacity:.5; } .ds-plate-type .t { margin-top:14px; font:italic 400 1.05rem/1.35 'Literata',Georgia,serif; color:#c2b8aa; } .ds-plate-type .c { margin-top:10px; font:500 13px/1.5 'Archivo',sans-serif; color:#978d80; }

components.name: Log Entry + Stage Rule (Polyglot)
components.description: A ruled interpreter-log entry: gutter number + direction, heard small in Ink 3, translation large. The live newest entry carries the equal-thirds stage rule (Heard · Translated · Spoken). No card, no bubble.
components.html:
1. 03EN→ES

    How long does that take?

    ¿Cuánto tiempo tarda eso?

  2. 04ES→EN

    Unos veinte minutos. Su andén es el cuatro.

    About twenty minutes. Your platform is number four.

    HeardTranslatedSpoken
components.css: .ds-turns { list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; max-width:880px; background:#161514; font-family:'Archivo',sans-serif; } .ds-turn { display:grid; grid-template-columns:58px minmax(0,1fr) auto; column-gap:16px; padding:18px 0 17px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10); } .ds-turn:last-child { border-bottom-color:transparent; } .ds-turn__g { display:grid; align-content:start; gap:5px; padding-top:3px; } .ds-turn__no { font:600 12px/1 'Archivo',sans-serif; color:#928d83; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; letter-spacing:.02em; } .ds-turn__dir { font:700 10.5px/1 'Archivo',sans-serif; color:#928d83; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-turn__heard { margin:0; font:400 15px/1.45 'Archivo',sans-serif; color:#928d83; } .ds-turn__said { margin:6px 0 0; font:500 1.24rem/1.32 'Archivo',sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.015em; color:#c3bfb6; max-width:36em; text-wrap:pretty; } .ds-turn--latest .ds-turn__said { font-size:clamp(1.55rem,4.2vw,2.1rem); line-height:1.18; letter-spacing:-.025em; color:#f2efe9; } .ds-tibtn { width:36px; height:36px; display:inline-grid; place-items:center; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid transparent; background:transparent; color:#928d83; cursor:pointer; transition:background .16s, color .16s; } .ds-tibtn:hover { background:#201f1d; color:#58C0C9; border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.10); } .ds-tibtn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #FFD500; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-stages { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:3px; max-width:420px; margin-top:16px; } .ds-stage { display:grid; gap:7px; font:600 10.5px/1 'Archivo',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.07em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#928d83; } .ds-stage i { display:block; height:3px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.18); } .ds-stage:first-child i { border-radius:3px 0 0 3px; } .ds-stage:last-child i { border-radius:0 3px 3px 0; } .ds-stage.is-done { color:#c3bfb6; } .ds-stage.is-done i { background:#f2efe9; } .ds-stage.is-now { color:#f2efe9; } .ds-stage.is-now i { background:#928d83; }

components.name: Talk Key (Polyglot)
components.description: The instrument's single gold action. Stays gold in every live state: idle, listening (press gold + timer + Ink-on-Gold level bars), translating (spinner). Only offline takes it off gold.

narrative.overview: BakerRang's consumer front door is a matched tool kit laid out as a printed directory: a workshop of small, sharp tools from one maker, indexed with editorial and signage discipline. It is warm and distinctive but modern and restrained — not literal skeuomorphism. The workbench character comes entirely from precision: exact alignment, hairline rules, tactile-but-quiet controls, small machined radii, and one shared drawing hand across every tool emblem so the set reads as a matched kit. This is the shared consumer world, reused across the launcher and every future per-product app; family resemblance lives in charcoal ground, reserved gold, Archivo/Archivo Expanded, flat planes and 1px rules, while each product keeps its own muted accent and drawn emblem. It is deliberately distinct from the platform's Business Workshop world. Dark is the signature default; a fully designed warm light mode is a first-class peer. The world refuses the category default (a hero over a uniform grid of cards) and rejects glassmorphism, ambient gradients, interchangeable cards, card-in-card, pills-everywhere, oversized vague heroes, icon+heading+subtitle repetition, and stat-grid dashboards. Depth is real but quiet — offset+blur shadows, never blur/glass.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal ground with gold reserved to the brand mark and the single primary action.
Directory/index rows with distinct drawn SVG emblems, never a uniform card grid.
Archivo Expanded signage headings over Archivo body, tight and confident.
Flat planes separated by 1px rules and restrained real shadows; no glass, no gradients.
Per-tool muted accent, one shared emblem stroke weight; a matched tool kit.
Small machined radii (4px controls, 8px panels); light/dark/system all first-class.

rules.name: The Reserved Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold is the brand and exactly one action. If a screen shows more than one gold fill, or uses gold on anything other than the mark, the primary button, ::selection, or focus, it is wrong. Even the masthead headline's accentword is set in --ink, not gold.

rules.name: The Dark-Ink-on-Gold Rule
rules.body: Any element sitting on a gold fill uses #1a1a1a ink, never white.

rules.name: The One-Accent-Per-Tool Rule
rules.body: A product's accent appears only on its own emblem and hover state. Accents never mix on one surface and never tint text, backgrounds, or borders wider than 1px.

rules.name: The Expanded-for-Naming Rule
rules.body: Archivo Expanded is reserved for the wordmark, mastheads, and tool names. Body, descriptions, chips, and controls are always plain Archivo; never set a paragraph in the expanded face.

rules.name: The No-Glass Rule
rules.body: Depth is tonal planes + 1px rules + offset/blur shadow. Never backdrop-filter, translucency-as-material, or gradient fills to fake elevation.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Directory rows are borderless (with only a bottom hairline) until hovered, when they gain a Plane background, a full 1px border, a 2px translateX nudge, and the contact shadow.

rules.name: The Reading Layer Rule
rules.body: Pages are a product-scoped tonal plane over the shared desk. Only the leaf (library contents) and the spread (reader, compose, welcome) carry Page colours and Page Ink; chrome (bars, menus, dialogs, turn buttons, the page rule) stays on the world's desk/plane/ink tokens. A control sitting on the page swaps its hairline and hover to Page Line and Page 2.

rules.name: The Ember Marker Rule
rules.body: Story Ember (#F08A5D dark / #C25A34 light) has exactly three roles: the drawn Story Book emblem (including its use in the empty and compose-idle states), the ribbon "you stopped here" marker, and hover affordances. Never text, never a surface or button fill, never a border wider than 1px. The 9x22px ribbon is the only solid ember mark.

rules.name: The One Gold Action Still Rule
rules.body: Gold remains one primary action per surface ("Begin a new story", "Write the story", "Sign in with Google", "Try again"). On phones the library's gold action moves into a fixed bottom bar; it moves, it is never duplicated. The compose field's focus is a --gold-text underline: the world's focus role, not a second action.

rules.name: The Literata-for-Story Rule
rules.body: A named, explicit exception to The Expanded-for-Naming Rule, scoped to Story Book content only. Story text, story titles (recto heading, contents-entry titles, the inline rename field, the quoted title in the delete dialog, the italic running title in the reading bar) and Story Book mastheads (the "Stories" contents title, welcome headline, compose and not-found headings) are Literata. The app wordmark "Story Book" stays Archivo Expanded; every control, button, menu, label, meta line, byline, step and running head stays Archivo. Literata never appears outside Story Book content.

rules.name: The Rule-Not-Fold Gutter Rule
rules.body: The gutter is a single 1px Page Line rule. No fold shading, no gradient, no page curl, no spine.

rules.name: The Talk Key Is the Gold Rule
rules.body: In the instrument the talk key is the only gold fill, and it stays gold in every state. At idle it is gold. While listening it is press gold carrying an Ink-on-Gold timer and level bars. While translating it shows a spinner. It is never swapped for a red "recording" key or a glowing orb. On Welcome the only gold fill is "Sign in with Google", and the top-bar Sign in there is a ghost button. Gold Text appears only in the world's focus role: the focus outline, and the border of the type and find fields while they have focus.

rules.name: The Teal Marks the Tool Rule
rules.body: Polyglot Teal (#58C0C9 dark / #1f7d86 light, the contract's "Signal Teal") has two roles. It draws the Polyglot emblem (the switcher cell and the empty state), and it is the hover colour of an entry's copy and replay icons. It never sets text, a fill, a rule, the stage rule or the talk key.

rules.name: The Problems-in-Ink Rule
rules.body: Nothing heard, microphone blocked, translation failed, playback failed and offline are each written in Ink, with an Ink 3 explanation and a drawn line icon, inside the log or the dock. They never use Danger red, a toast or a coloured alert box. Danger stays with Sign out.

rules.name: The Heard-Small, Said-Large Rule
rules.body: Every entry sets what was heard in 15px Archivo 400 Ink 3 above what it became in Archivo 500. The translation is the loud line. The source is never the larger of the two.

rules.name: The Newest-Is-Loudest Rule
rules.body: Only the newest entry's translation is at display size, in Ink. When a new entry lands, the previous one drops to 1.24rem Ink 2 (1.02rem on phone). A newest translation longer than 64 characters drops one step, so it stays readable at arm's length without flooding the log.

rules.name: The Thumb-Reach Rule
rules.body: Every Polyglot control (pair, swap, voice, type, talk) lives in the composer. The top bar carries only ecosystem chrome, and the log carries only per-entry copy, replay, cancel and stop.

rules.name: The Docked Slab Rule
rules.body: The composer is the only raised object in the instrument: a full-width Plane slab with a hairline top rule and the upward dock shadow. The log never raises anything. Entries never become cards, boxes or bubbles.

rules.name: The Violet Marks Held Rule
rules.body: Sign Violet (#B79CE0 dark / #6E4FB4 light) has three roles. It draws the Sign emblem (the switcher cell, and the 46px emblem on the camera-off plate, which uses the dark value in both themes because it sits on the finder). It draws the held ticks (the check beside "Held" in the hold row, and the small tick on each held picker cell). And it is the hover border of a picker cell (a 1px 55% color-mix). It never sets text, fills, the hold rule, the crop marks or the camera key.

rules.name: The Camera Key Is the Gold Rule
rules.body: In the viewfinder the camera key is the only gold fill, and it stays gold in every state. It reads "Start camera", then "Starting…" (press gold, aria-disabled, an Ink-on-Gold spinner), then "Stop camera", and "Try again" after a problem. There is no disabled non-gold state and no red "recording" key. On Welcome the only gold fill is "Sign in with Google", and the top-bar Sign in is a ghost button. Gold Text appears only in the world's focus role (the focus outline, and the active picker cell's outline while the grid has focus).

rules.name: The Fixed Finder Rule
rules.body: The finder, its rail, its inks and its overlays are fixed values, and they are independent of theme. Light mode changes the ground, the target line, the picker and the chrome. It never lightens the camera, and it never tints the overlay ink.

rules.name: The Problems-in-Ink Rule (Sign)
rules.body: Camera blocked, camera in use, no camera, hand reader failed and paused are each written inside the finder plate: a drawn 30px line icon in Finder Ink 2, a 500 15.5px Finder Ink message, and a 13.5px Finder Ink 3 explanation. The camera key carries the way forward ("Try again" / "Start camera"). They never use Danger red, a toast or a coloured alert box. Danger stays with Sign out.

rules.name: The Reading-Is-Text Rule
rules.body: What Sign reads is always printed as text in the caption strip, in Archivo Expanded, as well as drawn at the hand. Match status is always words ("On target", "Held", "Not yet"), never colour alone. Every change is spoken through one polite live region ("Held: Letter L").

rules.name: The Stable Finder Rule
rules.body: The finder's size never changes across reading, holding, Held or a target change. The how-to reserves two lines, the hold row has fixed slots and a fixed height, and reading, holding and Held update the existing nodes rather than re-mounting them. Keyboard focus stays where it is. On Held it does not move (Next is not auto-focused). After Clear, focus moves to the Target trigger.

rules.name: The Printed Target Line Rule
rules.body: The target line sits on the ground, never on a Plane slab and never with Polyglot's upward dock shadow. The finder is the one object on the screen, and it is defined by tone, not by elevation.

dos: Do keep gold to the brand mark and the single primary action (plus ::selection and focus). One gold fill per surface, maximum.
Do use dark ink (#1a1a1a) on every gold fill, never white.
Do give each product one muted accent, expressed only on its drawn emblem and hover.
Do build tool lists as full-width directory rows grouped by job, with drawn emblems.
Do convey depth with tonal planes + 1px rules + restrained offset/blur shadow.
Do treat dark as the signature default and light as a fully designed peer; support system too.
Do hide the wordmark below 430px and let the BakerRang logo mark carry the brand.
Do draw every icon as an SVG on the shared 1.75 stroke weight.
Do (Story Book) set story text, story titles and Story Book mastheads in Literata; keep every control and the "Story Book" wordmark in Archivo / Archivo Expanded.
Do (Story Book) keep the light desk #e6e1d8 scoped to Story Book; the world's light ground stays #efece6 everywhere else.
Do (Story Book) draw the gutter as a 1px rule and outline plates with a 1px ring; plates use the 3px inner radius, spread and leaf the 8px panel radius.
Do (Polyglot) render every exchange as a ruled log entry: gutter number and direction, heard small, translation large, with the newest entry at the bottom just above the dock.
Do (Polyglot) keep the talk key gold in every live state, and make it the only gold fill in the instrument.
Do (Polyglot) show real progress with the three-part stage rule, advancing a stage only when its request returns.
Do (Polyglot) open pickers upward from the dock on desktop and as a bottom sheet on phones, with type-ahead.
Do (Polyglot) say problems in the log, in ink, with a way forward (Talk again, Type instead, Try again).
Do (Sign) keep the finder #0c0b0a with fixed white overlay ink in both themes. Only its 1px edge follows the theme.
Do (Sign) print what Sign reads as Archivo Expanded text in the caption strip, as well as drawing it at the hand, and state every match in words.
Do (Sign) keep the camera key gold in every state, and make it the only gold fill in the viewfinder.
Do (Sign) confirm Held with the focus lock (6px step-in, 1.5px → 3px, ~900ms hold; thicken only under reduced motion) plus the live-region announcement.
Do (Sign) keep the finder's size stable: a two-line how-to, a fixed-slot hold row, and no re-mounting of controls.
Do (Sign) say camera and reader problems inside the plate, in finder ink, with a drawn icon and the camera key as the way forward.
Do (Sign) open the handshape picker upward from Target on desktop and as a bottom sheet on phones, with type-ahead.
donts: Don't use glassmorphism, backdrop-filter, ambient/arbitrary gradients, or translucency-as-material.
Don't render tools as a uniform grid of icon+title+subtitle cards, or nest card-in-card.
Don't spread pills everywhere, build stat-grid dashboards, or ship oversized vague heroes.
Don't color a card border wider than 1px, or tint text/backgrounds with a tool accent.
Don't use emoji as icons or a system display face; use drawn SVG and Archivo Expanded.
Don't let the launcher become a dashboard/widget console — it is a front door and index.
Don't introduce literal skeuomorphism (wood, pegboard, screws, taped labels).
Don't (Story Book) use Story Ember as text, a surface or button fill, or a wide border; it is emblem, ribbon and hover only.
Don't (Story Book) add a second gold action to a Story Book surface, including inline rename.
Don't (Story Book) fake the book with texture, fold shading, curls or leather; proportion, folio, running head and serif carry it.
Don't let Literata or the page tokens leak into the launcher or other consumer apps.
Don't (Polyglot) use chat bubbles, cards, or a two-pane source/target board with a mic orb.
Don't (Polyglot) turn the talk key red, make it glow, or take it off gold while listening.
Don't (Polyglot) use Polyglot Teal for text, fills, rules or the stage rule. It is the emblem and hover only.
Don't (Polyglot) put controls in the top bar, or bring Story Book's desk, Page tokens or Literata into Polyglot.
Don't (Polyglot) use a native <select> for the language or voice choice.
Don't (Sign) put the camera in a rounded card on a glass panel, or beside a stat grid.
Don't (Sign) raise the target line onto a slab or give it a dock shadow.
Don't (Sign) turn the camera key red, make it glow, or take it off gold while the camera runs.
Don't (Sign) use Sign Violet for text, fills, the hold rule, the crop marks or the camera key. It is the emblem, the held ticks and cell hover only.
Don't (Sign) tint or theme the finder, its rail or its overlay ink.
Don't (Sign) bring Literata, Story Book's desk or Page tokens, or Polyglot's dock into Sign.
Don't (Sign) use a native <select> for the handshape choice.

notCanonized: Fonts (Archivo, Archivo Expanded) currently load from the Google Fonts CDN in the shipped comp; self-hosting is a tracked pre-ship task, not a design-system rule.
The comp carries a fixed review-controls widget (auth/theme toggles) for finish review; it is scaffolding, not a product component, and is not documented as a system pattern.

Story Book implementation: the comp (web/.impeccable/mocks/storybook-comp.html) loads Archivo, Archivo Expanded and Literata from Google Fonts; the build must self-host all three. Archivo + Archivo Expanded are already self-hosted in @bakerrang/web-tokens (packages/web-tokens/src/tokens.css); Literata (OFL, opsz subset, roman 400/500/600 + italic 400) ships inside apps/storybook. CDN loading is a comp shortcut, not a system rule.

Story Book comp, not canonized: the running-head slot carries chrome labels ('An example page' on welcome, 'New story' on compose) that act as eyebrows; a running head is canonized only as the story's title.
Story Book comp one-offs, not canonized: white #fff folio numerals with text-shadow on filled generation slots, the 2px page-rule bar radius, and the review-controls scaffolding widget.
Pre-existing drift (not repaired, out of scope): narrative.rules 'The Reserved Gold Rule' body here says the masthead accentword is set in --ink, while DESIGN.md's rule sanctions it in --gold-text.

Polyglot implementation: the comp (web/.impeccable/mocks/polyglot-comp.html) loads Archivo and Archivo Expanded from Google Fonts; the app must use the self-hosted faces in @bakerrang/web-tokens. CDN loading is a comp shortcut, not a system rule. The .review panel is comp scaffolding, not a product component.

Polyglot comp stroke weights, not canonized: the empty-state emblem is drawn at stroke-width 1.5 and the talk-key mic/stop glyph at 2, against the world's single 1.75 stroke. The 1.75 rule stands; these are defects the comp carries.

Polyglot comp gold-text link, not canonized: the voice popover's Account link is set in --gold-text beside a gold talk key. Gold Text is canonized in Polyglot only in the focus role; the link is not a pattern for future surfaces.

Polyglot comp one-off sizes, not tokenized: the Welcome lead at 17.5px and UI micro-sizes of 12.5px (log note, hint), 13.5px (voice button, fine print) and 15.5px (language names, problem messages). Also the 2px bottom border on the keyboard-hint keycaps.

Pre-existing drift, Polyglot vs world (not repaired): the wordmark hides at 380px, not the world's 430px; the column gutter is clamp(16px, 4vw, 32px), not the world's clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem) (recorded as a scoped poly-gutter); shared .btn uses 9px/16px padding with a 40px min-height against the world's 10px/16px; ghost-button hover fills to Plane 2, while DESIGN.md says Plane.

Sign implementation: the comp (web/.impeccable/mocks/sign-comp.html) loads Archivo and Archivo Expanded from Google Fonts; the app must use the self-hosted faces in @bakerrang/web-tokens. The .review panel is comp scaffolding. The comp re-renders #root and restores focus for convenience; the app must update existing nodes (The Stable Finder Rule), not copy that. The camera image is synthetic (a drawn hand and skeleton stand in for live video); its room tones (#1b1a18, #191816, #221f1c, #24211e), skin tones (#57504a, #4c4640) and plate placeholder #151412 are not tokens.

Sign comp dead CSS, not canonized: .finder__rail .res (a camera-resolution style; the owner removed resolution from the rail) and .plate__idle .btn--ghost (no button is rendered inside the plate). Neither is a pattern.

Sign comp stroke weights, not canonized: the empty caption-glyph hand is drawn at stroke-width 1.5, the hold-state check at 2.2 and the picker held tick at 2.4, against the world's single 1.75 stroke. The 1.75 rule stands. The 1.5px crop-mark corner is a sanctioned signature, not an icon stroke.

Sign comp one-off sizes, not tokenized: the Welcome 'Sign in with Google' inline style (min-height 52px, padding 0 22px, 15px), the Welcome lead at 17px, idle-plate messages at 15.5px / 13.5px, and the reading label's 5-unit SVG corner radius (drawn over the video, not a CSS radius).

Sign vs direction contract (build wins): the contract says the target line sits 'between hairlines'; the build draws one hairline, above the hold row, and the finder's bottom edge bounds the line above. The camera key goes full width at <=760px, not only at the 640px phone breakpoint. The picker sheet caps at 88dvh (Polyglot's is 86dvh) and has no rise animation (it uses the .16s pop).

Pre-existing drift, Sign vs world (not repaired): the wordmark hides at 380px, not the world's 430px (as in Polyglot); the avatar is 36px and icon buttons 40px against DESIGN.md's 38px; ghost-button hover fills to Plane 2 while DESIGN.md says Plane (as in Polyglot). The colorMeta note for accent-sign still reads 'emblem + hover only'; the Sign layer's Violet Marks Held Rule adds held ticks and is the authority inside Sign.
